title: Nanoplastics and Water-Quality Survey of FMARS-Area Permafrost, Lake, and Snow Samples, with Resolute Bay Control Site (FMARS Crew 16)
duration: FMARS Crew 16 pre-mission and simulation period, June-July 2024; control-site sampling expedition at Resolute Bay documented 30 June 2024, with nanoplastics/permafrost sampling stated as a continuing science-plan objective through the Devon Island simulation
methods: Triplicate water and snow samples were collected at GPS-logged coordinates and stored in 80 mL Pyrex glass jars, including a designated control expedition upstream of any research station (Resolute Bay, near Char Lake) to establish a low-background baseline before on-station sampling at Devon Island. A co-located permafrost depth measurement was taken by digging to refusal with a pointed-tip shovel, backfilling in original depth order to minimise site disturbance. Ambient radiation was logged concurrently with a portable dosimeter at 2-minute intervals during the same expeditions. The Crew 16 science plan describes the same objectives as also covering algal/stromatolite sample testing at the same sites.
citation: SRC-flashline-crew-reports: FLASHLINE-16 Science Report-01, 30-06-2024 (Resolute Bay control-site water sampling, permafrost measurement, and radiation measurement); FLASHLINE-16 Daily Report 29-06-2024 (Chief Science Officer's objectives described as 'investigating permafrost and lake water samples for nanoplastics, testing algal and stromatolite samples'); FLASHLINE-16 Daily Report 30-06-2024 and Commander's Report 05-07-2024 (continued nanoplastics/permafrost sampling objectives).
methodology_notes: Author identified by an explicit 'Author:' byline on the Science Report giving name and role ('Chief Science Officer'); cross-referenced to crew_member FMARS-C16-2024-CM04 (Science Officer / Chief Science Officer role, GB nationality, PhD, per SRC-fmars-c16-crew-announcement) -- this is a higher-confidence PI attribution than RP-001/RP-002, which rely on report-authorship inference rather than an explicit named byline tied to the specific study item. The byline name itself is a real name and is not reproduced here, consistent with this dataset's pseudonymization practice. Domain classified as Biology given the primary stated objective (nanoplastics contamination); the study is genuinely multi-disciplinary, also encompassing permafrost geology and ambient radiation measurement at the same sites. No analysis results are reported in the extracted material -- samples were evidently intended for off-site or later-in-mission analysis -- so key_findings is omitted rather than inferred. See RP-002 for the relationship to FMARS Crew 15's prior-year microplastics study.
